title: Tanzanian Beef Kidney Stew
community: Enjoyed across Tanzania — a nutritious organ meat dish
author: Mama Salima
desc: Mchuzi wa Figo — Tanzanian beef kidney stew. Kidney cleaned, soaked, and cooked quickly in a spiced tomato-onion sauce with lemon and coriander. Intensely nutritious and fast to prepare — Tanzania's most economical organ meat dish.
longDesc: Kidney stew is prepared similarly to liver in Tanzania — soaked first to remove bitterness, then cooked quickly in a spiced sauce. The lemon juice at the end is the essential brightening note that makes it enjoyable even for those unfamiliar with organ meats.
steps: Remove fat and core from kidney. Slice into 2cm pieces.
Soak in cold salted water with lemon juice for 20 minutes. Drain.
Blanch in boiling water 3 minutes. Drain and rinse.
Cook onions until golden. Add garlic, ginger, spices.
Add kidney pieces. Cook 8—10 minutes — no longer.
Add lemon juice and coriander. Serve.
chefTips: Do not overcook kidney — becomes rubbery.
cookingScience: See TZA032 for organ meat cooking science.
sustainabilityTips: Kidney uses a part of the animal that would otherwise be wasted.
healthBenefits: Exceptionally rich in iron, B12, and folate.
culturalNote: Kidney stew is Tanzania's most nutritious affordable dish — eaten by communities that recognise the extraordinary nutritional value of organ meats and refuse to waste any part of the animal.
